logic.entry: From dataset day0 completed closes, seed average gain/loss with simple means of firstL close changes, first score at dayL. Thereafter avg_t=((L-1)*avg_previous+new_gain_or_loss)/L, Decimal28. RSI=100*avg_gain/(avg_gain+avg_loss); both zero use50. No OOS/fold resets or future values. When flat, enter iff RSI>entry_rsi; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff RSI<exit_rsi=45; equality/deadband preserves actual long state. No SMA filter, time cap or same-decision re-entry; terminal liquidation stays costed.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.scope: Wilder initialization/recursion only. Reuse our tested Decimal28 implementation; neutral50 for zero gain+loss is our explicit convention instead of that version zero.
Primary momentum oscillator context, not proof for this generated strength-entry45exit strategy.
